row.proto: void (void *activities_comp, char kind, uint16_t level, char inclusive)
row.notes: myteam-g2: Collects the activity records (via 14126f540/141265cf0) whose kind byte (+0x10) equals kind and whose level (ushort +0xa) is below (or <=, if inclusive) the given level, then calls Game_CareerActivities_RemoveActivity on every entry in both activity lists of the current activity slot (comp+0x410, 0x80 stride; lists +0x40 with 200-byte and +0x60 with 0xd8-byte entries). Called when a driver contract window is opened or a driver is selected. Modder hook: removes scheduled activities.

verify.notes: V9696 Collects by kind byte +0x10 and level ushort +0xa (< or <= by flag) then removes; matches.
